evals.prompt: 우리 팀이 다음 분기에 TypeScript로 전환하기로 결정했어. 반론 3가지를 들어줘.
evals.expected_output: 3개의 구체적이고 강력한 반론 제시. 각 반론은 TypeScript 전환의 실제 비용, 리스크, 대안을 구체적으로 다뤄야 함. Steel-man된 position, 숨은 가정, precedent, 핵심 취약점, 가역성 프레임 포함. cross-functional 결정이므로 다중 페르소나 섹션도 활성화.
expectations: Exactly 3 counterarguments are presented (not more, not fewer unless justified)
Each counterargument is specific to TypeScript migration, not generic change-resistance arguments
A 'core vulnerability' or '핵심 취약점' section is present
The arguments are stated directly without excessive hedging ('some might argue...')
The response does NOT include a balanced 'but here are the benefits' section that undermines the adversarial framing
Each counterargument includes a type label ([structural], [assumption], [execution], or [timing]) and a severity level (low/medium/high/critical)
A 'Hidden Assumptions' or '숨은 가정' section is present listing 2-3 unstated premises
Each counterargument includes a 'Precedent' or '선례' line — either a real-world failure pattern OR explicit 'no clear precedent — speculative concern'
A 'Reversibility' or '가역성' line is present, classifying the decision as reversible or one-way door
A multi-perspective section is present (TypeScript migration affects engineers + on-call + onboarding) with 2-3 personas
The position is steel-manned (strongest version stated) before being attacked
Response is in Korean (matching prompt language)

evals.prompt: Devil's advocate: we should sunset our mobile app and go web-only to reduce maintenance overhead.
evals.expected_output: 3 strong counterarguments against going web-only, covering user behavior, competitive positioning, and technical/business risks. Steel-manned position, hidden assumptions, precedent, core vulnerability, reversibility frame. Multi-persona section active (cross-functional: product, GTM, ops, users).
expectations: 3 counterarguments are presented
Arguments are steel-manned — they represent the strongest possible case against web-only
A core vulnerability section is present identifying the deepest structural flaw
Arguments are specific to mobile-vs-web tradeoffs, not generic product strategy platitudes
Response is in English (matching the prompt language)
Each counterargument includes a type label ([structural], [assumption], [execution], or [timing]) and a severity level (low/medium/high/critical)
A 'Hidden Assumptions' section is present listing 2-3 unstated premises
Each counterargument includes a 'Precedent' line — either a real-world failure pattern OR explicit 'no clear precedent — speculative concern'
A 'Reversibility' line is present, classifying sunsetting the mobile app (likely one-way door given user reinstall friction)
A multi-perspective section is present (sunsetting a product is cross-functional) covering 2-3 stakeholders (e.g., user, competitor, on-call, CFO)
The position is steel-manned (strongest case for web-only) before being attacked

evals.prompt: 이 설계의 반대 입장 검토해줘: 우리 스타트업은 초기부터 멀티테넌트 SaaS 아키텍처로 시작해야 한다. 처음부터 제대로 만들어야 나중에 고생 안 한다.
evals.expected_output: 멀티테넌트 초기 도입에 대한 강력한 반론. 초기 스타트업 맥락의 복잡성 비용, YAGNI, 피벗 가능성. 숨은 가정, precedent, 핵심 취약점, 가역성. 멀티테넌시 결정은 아키텍처 + 사업 결정이므로 다중 페르소나 활성화.
expectations: Counterarguments are presented in Korean (matching prompt language)
Arguments address the specific startup context — not just 'multi-tenancy is complex' in the abstract
The '핵심 취약점' section is present
At least one argument challenges the 'premature optimization' nature of the claim
No section that softens the critique by restating the benefits of multi-tenancy
Each counterargument includes a type label ([structural], [assumption], [execution], or [timing]) and a severity level (low/medium/high/critical)
A '숨은 가정' section is present listing 2-3 unstated premises (e.g., '피벗 안 한다', '초기 도메인 경계가 명확하다')
Each counterargument includes a '선례' line — either a real-world failure pattern OR explicit 'no clear precedent — speculative concern'
A '가역성' line is present (multi-tenant from day one tends to be one-way door — schemas, tenant isolation become hard to undo)
A multi-perspective section is present (architecture + business decision) with 2-3 personas
The position is steel-manned ('처음부터 제대로'의 강한 버전) before being attacked
